definitions.gloss: appearing in succession, occurring one after another
definitions.explanation: Things of the same kind appearing or occurring repeatedly in quick succession. Often used for problems, incidents, or notable events that keep happening.

examples.japanese: {事故|じこ}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Accidents are occurring one after another.

examples.japanese: {不祥事|ふしょうじ}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}して{信頼|しんらい}を{失|うしな}った。
examples.english: Scandals kept occurring one after another and trust was lost.

examples.japanese: {猛暑|もうしょ}の{影響|えいきょう}で{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}の{患者|かんじゃ}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}した。
examples.english: Due to the extreme heat, heatstroke patients appeared one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with negative or noteworthy events — accidents, scandals, problems, complaints. Can also be used neutrally for a series of notable occurrences. The pattern is subject + が + {続出|ぞくしゅつ}する.

FORMS:
{続|ぞく} (continue, follow) + {出|しゅつ} (appear, emerge).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {頻発|ひんぱつ}: occurring frequently
- {多発|たはつ}: occurring in large numbers
- {相次|あいつ}ぐ: to occur one after another (verb)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事故|じこ}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}する: accidents occur in succession
- {苦情|くじょう}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}する: complaints pour in
- {被害|ひがい}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}する: damage cases keep appearing
- {問題|もんだい}が{続出|ぞくしゅつ}する: problems keep arising
